write_up: You run a summer jobs program and supervise coordinators and seasonal staff. A recruiter can follow your progression at Harbor Pathways, but has to guess how many students the program places and how much work sits with the team.

The summer jobs line is the best model: it names the program, the students and the employers in one sentence. Add the number of students placed, then bring that same detail to the workshops and career fair.

cards.line: - Manage a summer jobs program placing high school students with local employers
cards.cannot_tell: The program is easy to picture, but a recruiter can't tell how many students you place. That's a central measure of the work.
cards.example: Manage a summer jobs program placing [number] high school students with local employers [time period]
cards.question: How many high school students does the program place, and over what period?

cards.line: - Supervise 4 program coordinators and 20 seasonal staff
cards.cannot_tell: The team count is useful. What the coordinators and seasonal staff handle is still a blank.
cards.example: Supervise 4 program coordinators and 20 seasonal staff who [what the team handles]
cards.question: What do the coordinators and seasonal staff handle?

cards.line: - Recruit and onboard employer partners
cards.cannot_tell: A recruiter knows why the employer partners matter from the summer jobs line, but not how many you recruit and onboard.
cards.example: Recruit and onboard [number] employer partners [time period]
cards.question: How many employer partners do you recruit and onboard, and over what period?

cards.line: - Coordinated job readiness workshops for students
cards.cannot_tell: The workshops have a purpose, but their reach is missing. How many students attended?
cards.example: Coordinated job readiness workshops for [number] students [time period]
cards.question: How many students attended the workshops, and over what period?

cards.line: - Organized an annual career fair
cards.cannot_tell: An annual career fair is a concrete piece of work. The number of attendees would show how big an event you organized.
cards.example: Organized an annual career fair attended by [number] people
cards.question: How many people attended the career fair?

fit.note: Your experience points to youth workforce program management, with staff supervision, employer partnerships and grant reporting. Adding placement and attendance counts would show how much of that work you handle.
